gate_summary: NO_PACKAGE: an e-mail request to the vendor's published contact address is the only published route to a package and a licence, no request has been made from here, and the advertised evaluation capacity cannot be checked against the frozen workload.

acquisition_route.request_channel: an e-mail request to the vendor's published contact address
supporting_locators: https://github.com/id3Technologies/finger-sdk-samples/blob/75d02adc5adef73009a85cefd48231fb7803ac48/README.md — 'To run any of the samples, you need to get a license from id3 Technologies. For that, you must contact us'; and 'once your request will be accepted, you will receive both a license activation key and a ZIP archive containing the SDK itself'

https://github.com/id3Technologies/finger-sdk-samples/blob/75d02adc5adef73009a85cefd48231fb7803ac48/README.md — activation runs against an activation key and a host hardware code, producing a licence file

https://github.com/id3Technologies/finger-sdk-samples/blob/75d02adc5adef73009a85cefd48231fb7803ac48/python/RecognitionCLI.py — the sample's first executable line is a licence check, with the comment that it must happen 'Before calling any function of the SDK'

acquisition_checklist.basis: access-qualification.json: no request has been made and no package has been delivered

public-product-observations.json: sdk_index_lists_platforms — the vendor offers Linux x86-64 and Windows x86-64 builds, which is what this project could host. Support for the *delivered* package is confirmed against that package at delivery
access-qualification.json: an activation key is issued by the vendor with the package, and none has been issued here
access-qualification.json: activation was never attempted, so it neither succeeded nor failed
access-qualification.json: which Finger modules a licence enables is a property of an issued licence

acquisition_checklist.requirement: licence is usable for local research
acquisition_checklist.basis: access-qualification.json: usability for local research needs both a licence and Stage 8E's decision over it, and there is neither

findings: no delivered package is present in the local artifact store
no package identity is frozen, because no package was delivered: the vendor's published route delivers one only on request

runtime_target.why_not_chosen: The evaluation licence is single-platform, so the target is a decision taken before activation. No activation has been attempted, so no target has been locked, and alternating between two platforms under one algorithm fingerprint is refused whichever one is eventually chosen (spec section 33).

third_party_components.why: Stage 8E's own model refuses a manifest with no components, because a manifest that describes nothing describes nothing. The SDK package, its models and its licence are third-party components and will be enrolled as such when one of them exists (spec section 7).
component_kinds_that_would_be_enrolled: each model artifact the extractor loads
the activated licence file, which is stored locally and never described by its bytes

notes: This gate is the stage's fail-fast. It costs one reading and it decides whether eight further gates are answerable at all (docs/adr/0095).
A refusal here is about access, not about the vendor's terms. Nothing in this document says the licence forbids research use, and nothing in it would change if it permitted every use.
